item.title: National Security Secretariat Rebranded as Human Security and Well-Being Body
item.description: St. Kitts and Nevis is transitioning from its Citizen Security Secretariat to a National Secretariat for Human Security and Well-Being, marking a major shift in how crime and safety are addressed. item.title: Youth Parliament to Host Mock Sitting for Commonwealth Day 2026
item.description: The Commonwealth Parliamentary Association (CPA), Nevis Island Branch – Youth Parliament will host a Mock Sitting of the Nevis Island Assembly in observance of Commonwealth Day 2026.
